capabilities: Suggest words learned from your notes or imported word lists, with fuzzy matching and usage ranking
Complete LaTeX/MathJax commands and environments with rendered previews and placeholders
Suggest front matter keys and values from the whole vault
Suggest callout types with their icons after typing > [!
Create and insert snippets with placeholders, and blacklist unwanted suggestions
extras: Inline suggestions and several small features are off by default; the README ends with a 'Looking for word lists?' section whose content (likely a link) is not included.
problem: Obsidian's editor offers no autocomplete for words, MathJax/LaTeX commands, front matter keys, or callout types, so writers must type them out in full.

relations.evidence: Callouts: > [! suggests callout types with their icons, optionally from Callout Manager.

summary: Auto-completion provider that suggests words, LaTeX commands, front matter keys, callout types, and snippets while you type.
